Custom Values

Custom values are like personalized settings that you can adjust to make your experience with our snapshot uniquely yours. They give you the power to tailor how the snapshot behaves, ensuring it fits your needs perfectly. Whether it's tweaking configurations or fine-tuning outputs, custom values empower you to make the snapshot work just the way you want it to.

If you go to Settings, then Custom Values, you will see the values we have for you. For each value, you can simply click the three dots on the side of each section to add your own value to the custom values.

Whatever you add to these values will update the entire snapshot with that information, whether it pertains to your website, funnels, automations, emails, and more.

Your Roofer Custom Values:

Referral Campaign Offer: Input the offer for your referral campaign. This will integrate into your referral offer workflow.

DR Campaign Offer: Add the offer for your DR (Direct Response) campaign. This will automatically update within your DR campaign workflow.

Google Review Link (Continuous Reputation Management): Insert the Google review link for your roofing business. This link will facilitate continuous reputation management automation.

Google Review Link (Review Campaign): This is where you'll add the roofing business's review link, which will be the same as the one mentioned above.

Holiday Email Offer: Customize the offer you wish to run within the 13 beautifully designed holiday emails.

Roofing Consultation Calendar Link: Add your roofing consultation calendar link here. It will be utilized in certain automations.

Service Area: Specify the service area for your roofing business.

2. Pipelines

Understanding Sales Pipelines

A sales pipeline is a visual representation of the stages a prospect goes through during the sales process, from initial contact to closing the deal. It helps businesses track and manage their sales activities, allowing them to identify bottlenecks, prioritize leads, and optimize their sales efforts effectively.

Snapshot Pipelines

In our snapshot, you'll find three distinct pipelines tailored to streamline your sales processes:

DR Campaign Pipeline: This pipeline is designed specifically for managing leads generated from your DR campaigns. It helps you track and nurture these leads through the various stages of the sales cycle until they convert into customers.

Review Campaign Pipeline:The review campaign pipeline allows you to see all of your review requests that were sent through your review campaign, allowing you to see how many left a review versus those who didn't.

Main Roofer Leads Pipeline: The main Roofer leads pipeline serves as the central hub for managing all your roofing-related leads. Whether they come from website forms, web chats, or other sources, this pipeline enables you to organize, track, and prioritize these leads effectively to maximize conversion opportunities.

With these three automated pipelines at your disposal, you can efficiently manage your sales activities, nurture leads, and drive revenue growth for your roofing business.

3. Calendars

Automated calendars are powerful tools that streamline scheduling processes, improve organization, and enhance productivity for businesses. They automate the process of booking appointments, managing service schedules, and coordinating activities, allowing businesses to efficiently allocate resources and provide exceptional service to their customers.

Snapshot Automated Calendars

In the roofing snapshot, you'll find three specialized automated calendars designed to simplify scheduling and streamline customer interactions:

Roofing Consultation Calendar: This calendar is specifically tailored to handle consultations with new leads and potential customers. It facilitates the booking of appointments for initial roofing consultations, allowing potential clients to easily schedule a time to discuss their roofing needs. Anyone who books an appointment on this calendar will be automatically updated in the roofing sales pipeline, enabling seamless lead management and nurturing processes. The Roofing Consultation Calendar ensures that your team can efficiently manage and follow up with new leads, maximizing conversion opportunities.

Roofing Project Calendar: The Roofing Project Calendar is dedicated to managing ongoing roofing projects. It allows you to schedule and track various stages of roofing projects, from initial assessments to project completion. This calendar helps in coordinating with your team, suppliers, and clients, ensuring that every project is on track and deadlines are met. By using this calendar, you can provide timely updates to clients, allocate resources effectively, and maintain an organized workflow for all your roofing projects.

Roof Maintenance Calendar: The Roof Maintenance Calendar is designed to handle routine maintenance appointments and service calls. It enables you to schedule regular maintenance checks, repairs, and inspections, ensuring that your clients' roofs remain in optimal condition. This calendar helps you manage recurring maintenance tasks efficiently, providing reliable and timely service to your customers. By automating the scheduling of maintenance appointments, you can ensure consistent follow-up and enhance customer satisfaction.

Appointment Confirmation, Reminders, no-show, & Cancellation Automation

Automating appointment confirmations, reminders, no-show notifications, and cancellations streamlines communication with clients and ensures that your business runs smoothly. These automations help manage appointments effectively, reducing missed appointments and cancellations, and enhancing overall customer experience.

Snapshot Appointment Automation

Appointment Confirmation: When a customer books an appointment using any of the automated calendars, they will receive an immediate confirmation message. This message reassures the customer that their appointment has been successfully scheduled and provides important details about the appointment.

Appointment Reminders: Prior to the scheduled appointment, the customer will receive automated reminders via text and/or email. These reminders reduce the likelihood of no-shows and ensure that the customer is well-prepared for their appointment. Reminders can be customized to be sent at various intervals (e.g., 24 hours, 1 hour before the appointment).

No-Show Notifications: If a customer does not show up for their scheduled appointment, the system will automatically tag them as a no-show. This triggers a notification to the business owner and updates the customer’s status in the pipeline. For the Roofing Consultation Calendar, the no-show status will be reflected in the roofing sales pipeline, allowing for appropriate follow-up actions.

Cancellation Notifications: When a customer cancels their appointment, they will receive a cancellation confirmation message. The system will tag them as canceled, notify the business owner, and update the customer’s status in the pipeline. For the Roofing Consultation Calendar, the canceled status will be updated in the roofing sales pipeline, ensuring that all changes are tracked and managed.

Key Features and Customization Options

Tagging and Notifications: Each automation ensures that the customer receives the appropriate tag (e.g., appointment booked, no-show, canceled) and that the business owner is notified of the change in status. This helps maintain an organized and up-to-date customer database.

Pipeline Integration: For the Roofing Consultation Calendar, appointments are seamlessly integrated with the roofing sales pipeline. When an appointment is booked, the customer is moved to the "appt booked" stage. If they cancel or do not show up, their status is updated accordingly, enabling efficient tracking and management of leads.

Customizable Messaging: All confirmation, reminder, no-show, and cancellation messages can be customized to reflect your brand's voice and communication style. This ensures that your customers receive consistent and professional communication from your business.

Benefits of Appointment Automation

Improved Appointment Management: Automating confirmations, reminders, and notifications reduces the administrative burden on your team and ensures that all appointments are managed efficiently.

Reduced No-Shows and Cancellations: Timely reminders and notifications help minimize the number of missed appointments and cancellations, improving the overall efficiency of your business operations.

Enhanced Customer Experience: Automated and personalized communication enhances the customer experience, making it easy for clients to stay informed about their appointments and reducing the likelihood of confusion or missed appointments.

Streamlined Lead Management: Integration with the roofing sales pipeline ensures that all appointment-related changes are tracked and managed within your existing workflow, providing a comprehensive view of your customer interactions and sales processes.

With our appointment confirmation, reminders, no-show, and cancellation automation, you can streamline communication, improve appointment management, and enhance the overall efficiency of the roofing business.

6. Funnels

Understanding Roofing Funnels

Roofing funnels are strategic marketing pathways designed to attract, engage, and convert potential customers into leads or clients for roofing services. These funnels guide prospects through a series of steps, from initial awareness to taking action, ultimately driving them towards booking a service or making a purchase. In our snapshot, you'll find four specialized roofing funnels tailored to address different marketing objectives and customer needs.

Snapshot Roofing Funnels

Eligibility Roofing Funnel:

Purpose: This funnel helps potential customers determine their eligibility for roofing services or financing options.

Eligibility Form: A detailed form that collects information about the customer's current roofing situation, financial status, and service requirements.

Follow-Up: Automated follow-up emails and texts providing further details and next steps based on the customer's responses.

Customization: Adjust the form fields, qualification criteria, and follow-up messaging using custom values to match your specific services and target audience.

Proven Conversion: This funnel has been tested and optimized to effectively convert interested leads into qualified prospects.

Free Estimate Survey Funnel:

Purpose: This funnel is designed to capture leads by offering a free roofing estimate based on a quick survey.

Survey Form: A concise survey form that gathers essential information about the customer's roofing needs and property details.

Estimate Offer: A compelling offer for a free roofing estimate, encouraging customers to submit the survey.

Lead Management: Automated notifications and lead tagging for follow-up and sales pipeline integration.

Customization: Modify the survey questions and estimate offer using custom values to reflect your specific roofing services and promotional strategy.

Proven Conversion: This funnel is designed to effectively engage potential customers and convert survey respondents into leads.

New Roof Deal Funnel (0 Down, 0 Interest + $500 Off):

Purpose: This funnel promotes a special deal for new roof installations, emphasizing attractive financing options and discounts.

Deal Highlights: Clear presentation of the deal's benefits, including no down payment, no interest, and a $500 discount.

Contact Form: A form for customers to express their interest and provide contact information.

Incentive Messaging: Strong call-to-action and persuasive messaging to encourage quick sign-ups.

Customization: Tailor the deal details, contact form fields, and incentive messaging using custom values to match your current promotions and target market.

Proven Conversion: This funnel leverages compelling offers to effectively convert interested visitors into leads.

Roof Inspection Funnel:

Purpose: This funnel encourages customers to schedule a roof inspection to assess the condition of their roof and identify potential issues.

Inspection Offer: An enticing offer for a comprehensive roof inspection, highlighting the benefits of regular inspections.

Booking Form: A form for customers to book an inspection appointment, collecting necessary details about their property and availability.

Educational Content: Information about the importance of roof inspections and what to expect during the process.

Customization: Customize the inspection offer, booking form fields, and educational content using custom values to align with your roofing services and customer needs.

Proven Conversion: This funnel is structured to effectively convert interested prospects into scheduled inspection appointments.

With these specialized and customizable roofing funnels, you can effectively attract, engage, and convert leads, driving growth and success for your roofing business.

Funnel Automations:

Each funnel will be fully automated, with the name of each automation matching the corresponding funnel. Similarly, the funnel forms will be named identically for easy organization. Here’s a detailed overview of the automation process:

Seamless Lead Updates: When someone opts into a funnel, their information will be automatically updated in the sales pipeline. This ensures that all lead details are captured and organized effectively.

Appropriate Tagging: Each lead will be tagged appropriately based on the funnel they opted into. This helps in segmenting and managing leads efficiently.

Internal Notifications: You will receive an internal notification each time a lead opts into a funnel. This allows for prompt follow-up and engagement with new prospects.

Personalized Communication: Upon opting in, the lead will receive a personalized text and email with their offer. This immediate response helps in nurturing the lead and keeping them engaged.

Appointment Reminders: If the lead proceeds to book an appointment through the funnel, the appointment reminder automations will be triggered. This includes confirmation messages, reminders, and follow-ups to ensure the lead shows up for the appointment.

Customization Options:

Customizable Automations: Each automation can be easily customized to match your branding and communication style. This ensures a cohesive and personalized experience for your leads.

Editable Text Messages: The text messages sent to leads can also be tailored to reflect your business’s voice and messaging, making the communication more relevant and engaging.

Benefits of Funnel Automation:

Efficiency: Automations streamline the process of managing leads, reducing manual effort and ensuring timely follow-ups.

Organization: Consistent naming of automations and forms keeps your workflow organized, making it easier to track and manage leads.

Personalization: Customizable automations and messages allow for a personalized approach, enhancing the customer experience and increasing the likelihood of conversion.

With these automated processes in place, you can efficiently manage leads, maintain consistent communication, and improve your overall sales and marketing efforts. Each step is designed to optimize lead engagement and drive conversions, contributing to the growth and success of the roofing business.

8. Database Reactivation

Understanding Database Reactivation Campaigns

Database reactivation campaigns are strategic marketing initiatives aimed at re-engaging with inactive or lapsed leads in your database. These campaigns help revitalize your contact list, rekindle interest in your products or services, and ultimately drive conversions. In our snapshot, we offer two types of database reactivation campaigns: a basic version and an advanced version, each offering unique features and functionalities.

Snapshot Database Reactivation Campaigns

Basic Database Reactivation Campaign: The basic campaign provides a straightforward approach to reactivating dormant leads in your database. You have the flexibility to customize the offer for this campaign using a custom value. This campaign aims to reconnect with inactive leads, remind them of your value proposition, and encourage them to re-engage with your business.

Advanced Database Reactivation Campaign (DR Campaign): The advanced campaign takes database reactivation to the next level by incorporating dynamic lead management features. Similar to the basic campaign, you can customize the offer using a custom value. However, this campaign goes a step further by updating leads in a dedicated DR campaign pipeline. If a lead responds positively to the campaign, they will be moved to a "responded" status in the pipeline, indicating active interest. Conversely, if they indicate disinterest, they will be moved to a "not interested" status, allowing you to focus your efforts on more promising leads.

10. Referral Campaign Workflow

Referral campaigns are powerful marketing strategies designed to leverage the existing customer base to acquire new customers. By incentivizing customers to refer friends, family, or colleagues to your business, referral campaigns can rapidly expand your customer network and drive growth. In our snapshot, we offer a comprehensive referral campaign feature that enables you to easily create and manage referral programs tailored to your business needs.

Snapshot Referral Campaign

Customizable Referral Incentives: Our referral campaign feature allows you to customize the incentives offered to customers for referring new business. By utilizing custom values, you can tailor the incentives to align with your promotional strategies and budget. Whether it's offering discounts, freebies, or exclusive rewards, the referral campaign feature empowers you to create compelling incentives that motivate customers to spread the word about your business.

Benefits of Referral Campaigns

Expanded Customer Base: Referral campaigns tap into the power of word-of-mouth marketing to attract new customers. By leveraging the networks of your existing customers, you can rapidly expand your customer base and drive growth for your business.

Enhanced Trust and Credibility: Recommendations from friends or family members are highly trusted by consumers. By encouraging referrals, you can capitalize on this trust and credibility to attract high-quality leads and convert them into loyal customers.

Cost-Effective Marketing: Referral campaigns are a cost-effective way to acquire new customers compared to traditional advertising channels. Since referrals come from satisfied customers, the cost per acquisition is typically lower, resulting in a higher return on investment.

With our customizable referral campaign feature, you can harness the power of word-of-mouth marketing to drive growth and success for your business.

11. Incoming Lead Follow Up Workflows

Incoming lead follow-up workflows are automated processes designed to promptly respond to inquiries and messages from potential customers across various communication channels. These workflows ensure that every lead receives a timely and personalized response, increasing the chances of conversion and providing exceptional customer service. In our snapshot, we offer four incoming lead follow-up workflows tailored to different communication channels: Google My Business (GMB) message, email, Facebook message, and Instagram direct message (DM).

Snapshot Incoming Lead Follow-Up Workflows

GMB Message Workflow: This workflow is triggered when someone sends a message through your Google My Business listing. The workflow automatically tags the lead, updates their status in the pipeline as responded to, and notifies the roofer. You can easily customize the messaging and actions of this workflow to suit your preferences and brand voice.

Email Workflow: The email workflow is activated when a lead reaches out via email. Similar to the GMB message workflow, it tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the roofer, ensuring a prompt and efficient response to email inquiries.

Facebook Message Workflow: When a potential customer sends a message to your Facebook page, the Facebook message workflow springs into action. It tags the lead, updates their status, and alerts the roofer, enabling seamless communication and follow-up through Facebook Messenger.

Instagram DM Workflow: The Instagram DM workflow handles incoming direct messages on your Instagram account. It automatically tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the roofer, facilitating quick and effective engagement with potential customers on Instagram.

With our incoming lead follow-up workflows, you can effectively manage inquiries and messages across multiple communication channels, providing timely and personalized responses to potential customers.

12. Reputation Management

Reputation management is crucial for maintaining a positive image and credibility for your roofing business. It involves actively monitoring and influencing how your brand is perceived by customers, both online and offline. In our snapshot, we offer comprehensive reputation management features to help you proactively manage and enhance your online reputation.

Snapshot Reputation Management Features

Ongoing Reputation Management: After each service, customers have the option to request a review. This process allows you to gather feedback and testimonials from satisfied customers, helping to boost your online reputation and credibility.

Google Review Campaign: Our Google review campaign is designed to generate a significant number of new reviews for your roofing business. You can input a list of existing customers into the campaign to kickstart the process, resulting in 30-100 new reviews right away. Customers in this campaign are managed through a dedicated review campaign pipeline, allowing you to track who has left a review and who hasn't.

Key Features and Customization Options

Custom Review Links: The review link for both ongoing reputation management and the Google review campaign can be customized using custom values. This allows you to tailor the review links to your branding and preferences.

Trigger Links: Each campaign includes two trigger links that serve as indicators of customer engagement. These trigger links, associated with the review custom value links, help you track whether customers have clicked on the review links or not, if clicked they will no longer get review reminders and so on.

13. Invoice Reminders, Cancellation, & Refunds

Automation for invoice management streamlines the process of handling invoices, reminders, cancellations, and refunds, ensuring smooth and efficient financial transactions for your roofing business. These automated workflows help you stay organized, reduce administrative burden, and provide a seamless experience for your customers.

Snapshot Automation for Invoice Management

Invoice Reminders Automation: This automation sends timely reminders to customers who have outstanding invoices, prompting them to make payment. By automating invoice reminders, you can minimize late payments, improve cash flow, and maintain positive relationships with your customers.

Cancellation Automation: When a customer cancels a service, this automation ensures that the cancellation process is handled smoothly and efficiently. It updates the customer's status, triggers any necessary refunds, and notifies relevant stakeholders, allowing you to manage cancellations with ease and professionalism.

Refunds Automation: In cases where refunds are warranted, this automation handles the refund process seamlessly. It initiates the refund, updates the customer's status accordingly, and provides notifications to both the customer and your team, ensuring transparency and accountability in the refund process.

Key Features and Customization Options

Timely Notifications: Each automation sends timely notifications to customers and stakeholders, keeping them informed throughout the invoicing, cancellation, and refund processes.

Customizable Messaging: You have the flexibility to customize the messaging of each automation to align with your branding and communication style, ensuring a consistent and professional experience for your customers.

14. Missed Call Text Back

The Missed Call Text Back Automation is a proactive response system designed to engage with potential leads who have attempted to contact the roofer business but were unable to connect via phone. This automation sends a text message to the missed caller, providing them with an opportunity to book a consultation or appointment with your business. By leveraging this automation, you can effectively follow up with missed leads and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers.

Snapshot Missed Call Text Back Automation

Engagement Text Message: When a call goes unanswered or is missed, the automation triggers a text message to be sent to the caller's phone number. The message is crafted to be engaging and inviting, encouraging the caller to consider booking a consultation or appointment with your roofing business.

Call to Action: The text message includes a clear call to action, such as a link to your online booking system or a phone number to call back, making it easy for the recipient to take immediate action and schedule a consultation.

Personalization: To enhance engagement and relevance, the text message can be personalized with the caller's name or other relevant details, creating a more personalized and tailored experience for the recipient.
